c10.rule: Distinguish fixture/protocol, real binary, managed execution, actual inference and desktop path by evidence; do not decide solely from the word keyless.

checkpoint_push.otherwise: continue local C12 and C13 before normal final commit; do not waive governance or idle solely to wait for push

dependency_semantics: A completed step means its actual outcome is known; an unresolved mandatory blocker propagates and never enables a success or unauthorized push.
report_only_path: If no safely runnable work remains, preserve candidate and give FEATURE_PARTIAL or REWORK with missing evidence; never manufacture review PASS.
invariants: Do not reset C00-C11 or reread all historic logs because the coordinator context changed.
Do not count C12-prep or C13-prep as actual product journey or formal review completion.

CP2 or an intermediate commit is not the endpoint of this task.
